audit.about: Cloudflare's security-audit skill run end to end, a coverage plan you approve, your review of every finding, and a signed report you approve.
audit.label: Security audit

candidate_verifier.about: Fresh agent that tries to disprove each candidate. Use a different model from the hunters, so they check each other.
candidate_verifier.label: Candidate verifier

coverage_critic.about: Fresh agent after each wave: finds gaps in the coverage, never findings.
coverage_critic.label: Coverage critic

hunter.about: Hunts one coverage unit at a time for real boundary failures. Most of the audit's spend.
hunter.label: Hunter

orchestrator.about: The parent agent: runs the skill's workflow, owns the run files, talks to you. This is the Claude Code session itself: switch it with /model.
orchestrator.label: Orchestrator

recon.about: Maps the architecture, trust boundaries and entry surfaces, and seeds the coverage ledger.
recon.label: Reconnaissance

record_verifier.about: Fresh agent that re-checks every final record against the source.
record_verifier.label: Record verifier

desk.about: Watches merge requests on a forge and reviews them on a loop: one reviewer per profile (security, devops, code), comments from your templates, approvals only as the desk's policy and modes allow. Never merges.
desk.label: Review desk

orchestrator.about: Keeps `desk next` running, spawns one reviewer per profile for each merge request, then hands the records to lacarta. This is the Claude Code session itself: switch it with /model.
orchestrator.label: Orchestrator

reviewer.about: Fresh subagent that reviews one merge request for one profile and writes its record. The profile's model, when the desk sets one, wins over this.
reviewer.label: Reviewer

verifier.about: Fresh subagent that tries to disprove a blocking finding before it can block. Use a different model from the reviewers, so they check each other.
verifier.label: Verifier

incident.about: One case, a security incident or a vulnerability to respond to: its timeline, investigations, evidence, indicators and response actions, with situation reports along the way and a final report. You approve every action and every report.
incident.label: Incident response

challenger.about: Fresh agent that tries to disprove a confirmed conclusion. Use a different model from the investigators, so they check each other.
challenger.label: Challenger

investigator.about: Subagent that works one investigation: collects evidence, records what it finds, proposes a conclusion.
investigator.label: Investigator

orchestrator.about: Coordinates the response: keeps the timeline, opens investigations, proposes actions, drafts the reports and talks to you. This is the Claude Code session itself: switch it with /model.
orchestrator.label: Coordinator

single.about: One agent session on one task: its chat, questions and activity.
single.label: Single agent

agent.about: The CLI session itself. Switch it in the terminal (`/model` in Claude Code); helpers it spawns use this model too.
agent.label: Agent

software.about: Specs, a phase plan, phases gated by functional and security reviews, a final review.
software.label: Software development

final_functional_review.about: Fresh agent that judges the whole repository against the specs.
final_functional_review.label: Final functional review

final_security_review.about: Fresh agent that audits the whole repository.
final_security_review.label: Final security review

functional_review.about: Reviews each phase against the functional spec and architecture.
functional_review.label: Functional review

implementation.about: Subagent that builds each phase's scope and its tests.
implementation.label: Implementation

orchestrator.about: Runs the framework, writes the specs, talks to you and coordinates the other agents. This is the Claude Code session itself: switch it with /model.
orchestrator.label: Orchestrator

security_review.about: Reviews each phase against the threat model and hunts for vulnerabilities.
security_review.label: Security review

spec_review.about: Fresh agent that checks the complete spec set for gaps and incoherences.
spec_review.label: Specification review
